COMPONENT.NAME: CSPRNG (cryptographic)

COMPONENT.NAME: seededRng (synchronous xorshift)

COMPONENT.NOTE: createGrid uses Date.now() as seed — NOT CSPRNG-derived. Grid layout not covered by commit-reveal fairness proof.

COMPONENT.NAME: SixPoolManager
COMPONENT.DIE_POOL: perFace=ceil(dim×dim/6)×6/6 tiles per face. Equal distribution. Pre-shuffled dieLive. Recycle dead→live on exhaustion.
COMPONENT.WILD_POOL: Size=ceil(dim×dim/4). Distribution: r lt 0.60→type0, lt 0.75→type1, lt 0.90→type2, else type3(true-wild=10%)
COMPONENT.BOARD_AWARENESS: NONE. No board state inputs. Sequential pre-shuffled draws.
COMPONENT.SEED: seededRng(hashSeedString(csprng.getSeed())) — hash of CSPRNG seed, not CSPRNG itself
